cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(synexia_shared_arrays LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(_shared_desktop_default ON)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "^(iOS|tvOS|watchOS|visionOS)$")
  set(_shared_desktop_default OFF)
endif()
option(SYNEXIA_SHARED_ARRAYS_JNI "Build the existing shared-array JNI target" ${_shared_desktop_default})
option(SYNEXIA_SHARED_ARENA_SHARED "Build the native arena as a shared library" ${_shared_desktop_default})
set(_shared_test_default ${_shared_desktop_default})
if(ANDROID)
  set(_shared_test_default OFF)
endif()
option(BUILD_TESTING "Build native contract tests" ${_shared_test_default})
include(CTest)
set(SYNEXIA_MINDEX_PLATFORM_TEST_ARENA "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/test/fixtures/arena.bin" CACHE FILEPATH
  "Existing SharedArrayPool-produced arena for the native contract tests")

if(SYNEXIA_SHARED_ARRAYS_JNI)
  if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "^(iOS|tvOS|watchOS|visionOS)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Apple device SDKs use SYNEXIA_SHARED_ARRAYS_JNI=OFF; no target JVM adapter is supplied")
  elseif(ANDROID)
    if(NOT CMAKE_ANDROID_NDK)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Android JNI requires an installed NDK toolchain")
    endif()
    # NDK jni.h comes from the target sysroot, without host JVM/AWT discovery.
  else()
    find_package(JNI REQUIRED)
  endif()
  # Reuse the common native-interop donor owner, scoped to this existing native target.
  set(mapbox_jni_owner "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../synexia-native-interop/src/main/cpp/third_party/mapbox-jni-ownership")
  include("${mapbox_jni_owner}/pin.cmake")
  add_library(synexia_shared_arrays SHARED shared_arrays.cpp shared_string_compare.cpp)
  target_include_directories(synexia_shared_arrays PRIVATE "${mapbox_jni_owner}/include")
  if(NOT ANDROID)
    target_include_directories(synexia_shared_arrays PRIVATE ${JNI_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  endif()
  target_compile_features(synexia_shared_arrays PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(synexia_shared_arrays PRIVATE /W4 /WX)
  else()
    target_compile_options(synexia_shared_arrays PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
  endif()
  if(ANDROID)
    target_link_options(synexia_shared_arrays PRIVATE "-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384" "-Wl,-z,common-page-size=16384")
  endif()
  install(TARGETS synexia_shared_arrays
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib LIBRARY DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
endif()

set(_shared_arena_kind STATIC)
if(SYNEXIA_SHARED_ARENA_SHARED)
  set(_shared_arena_kind SHARED)
endif()
add_library(synexia_shared_arena ${_shared_arena_kind}
  src/shared_arena.c src/shared_mapping.c)
target_include_directories(synexia_shared_arena PUBLIC
  "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>"
  "$<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>")
target_compile_features(synexia_shared_arena PRIVATE c_std_11)
set_target_properties(synexia_shared_arena PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(SYNEXIA_SHARED_ARENA_SHARED)
  target_compile_definitions(synexia_shared_arena PRIVATE SYNEXIA_SHARED_BUILD_SHARED=1)
else()
  target_compile_definitions(synexia_shared_arena PUBLIC SYNEXIA_SHARED_STATIC=1)
endif()
if(UNIX)
  target_compile_definitions(synexia_shared_arena PRIVATE _FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64)
endif()
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(synexia_shared_arena PRIVATE /W4 /WX)
else()
  target_compile_options(synexia_shared_arena PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
endif()
if(ANDROID)
  target_sources(synexia_shared_arena PRIVATE src/shared_android.c)
  target_link_libraries(synexia_shared_arena PRIVATE android)
  if(SYNEXIA_SHARED_ARENA_SHARED)
    target_link_options(synexia_shared_arena PRIVATE "-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384" "-Wl,-z,common-page-size=16384")
  endif()
endif()

if(BUILD_TESTING)
  add_executable(shared_arena_test test/shared_arena_test.c)
  target_link_libraries(shared_arena_test PRIVATE synexia_shared_arena)
  target_compile_features(shared_arena_test PRIVATE c_std_11)
  if(MSVC)
    # Keep portable fixture I/O while retaining all other warnings as errors.
    target_compile_definitions(shared_arena_test PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
    target_compile_options(shared_arena_test PRIVATE /W4 /WX /UNDEBUG)
  else()
    target_compile_options(shared_arena_test PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -UNDEBUG)
  endif()
  if(SYNEXIA_MINDEX_PLATFORM_TEST_ARENA)
    add_test(NAME shared_arena_c_abi COMMAND shared_arena_test
      "${SYNEXIA_MINDEX_PLATFORM_TEST_ARENA}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/shared_arena_case")
  else()
    message(STATUS "shared_arena_c_abi is not registered: supply SYNEXIA_MINDEX_PLATFORM_TEST_ARENA")
  endif()
endif()

install(TARGETS synexia_shared_arena EXPORT SynexiaMIndexSDKTargets
  ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib LIBRARY DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(FILES include/synexia_shared_arena.h DESTINATION include)
